description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class 'Coocook::Controller::Ajax::IngredientsEditor' with multiple methods for managing ingredients in a cooking project, including CRUD operations, reordering, and fetching related data.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Ajax::IngredientsEditor
classes.description: Catalyst controller class handling AJAX requests related to ingredients editing, including CRUD operations, reordering, and data retrieval.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained method that initializes the dish or recipe context based on URL parameters, attaching the corresponding object to the stash.

methods.name: get_all_ingredients
methods.description: Fetches all ingredients for the current dish or recipe and returns them in a format suitable for the ingredients editor.

methods.name: update_ingredient
methods.description: Updates an existing ingredient's comment, unit, and value based on AJAX request data.

methods.name: prepend_ingredient
methods.description: Prepares to add a new ingredient at the beginning of the list.

methods.name: append_ingredient
methods.description: Prepares to add a new ingredient at the end of the list.

methods.name: _xpend_ingredient
methods.description: Internal method to insert a new ingredient at a specified position (prepend or append).

methods.name: move_ingredient
methods.description: Reorders ingredients by moving one to a new position relative to another.

methods.name: delete_ingredient
methods.description: Deletes an ingredient, handling special cases if it is a dish ingredient with associated items.

methods.name: all_articles
methods.description: Retrieves all articles associated with the project.

methods.name: all_units
methods.description: Retrieves all units associated with the project, including related articles.

methods.name: add_ingredient
methods.description: Creates a new ingredient based on provided properties.
